verdict.rationale: Hatchet ships a documented official CLI with multiple subcommands (worker dev, tui, quickstart, profile) and a public installer script confirmed reachable in a runtime probe, indicating agent-native/dev-friendly workflows (local dev loop, TUI observability, quickstart scaffolding). Missing for 10: independent hands-on user review of the CLI itself (comments focus on the platform/queue, not CLI experience), and no evidence of AI-agent-specific CLI features beyond general dev tooling.
